content.text: Farmers, land managers and foresters across England are already making the most of the opportunities available through the 2026 Capital Grants offer.
This year, £225 million is available to support practical environmental improvements on farms and across the countryside.
This funding pot is 50% larger than in 2025, reflecting the growing demand for investment in nature, water quality, biodiversity and sustainable land management.
As anticipated, interest has been strong from the outset, with applicants eager to deliver projects that will have lasting benefits for both their land and the environment.
We committed to providing regular updates as funding is allocated, with milestones at 25%, 50% and 75% of the available budget.

Today, we can confirm that the first of those milestones has been reached: 25% of the 2026 Capital Grants budget has now been allocated, demonstrating the significant appetite for environmental investment across England's farming and rural communities.

This budget update relates solely to the Capital Grants 2026 offer. The capital grants available through the Countryside Stewardship Higher Tier (CSHT) offer are funded from a separate budget.
